headline: Executive order changes existing equal employment opportunity rules for federal government jobs and for companies with federal contracts.
what_it_does: This order amends two earlier executive orders on equal employment opportunity. One, Executive Order 11478, covers hiring and treatment of workers in the federal government. The other, Executive Order 11246, covers businesses that hold federal contracts. The title does not say exactly what was changed, so the specific new protections or rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal government employees and job applicants
who_it_affects.how: The rules on fair treatment in federal hiring and employment under Executive Order 11478 are changed.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that hold federal contracts and their workers
who_it_affects.how: The equal employment rules these employers must follow under Executive Order 11246 are changed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 21, 2014; the title does not give specific effective dates.
